rules.title: Use of eval on untrusted input surface
rules.message: eval() executes arbitrary code. If any attacker-controlled string reaches this call, it is RCE.
rules.fix: Parse structured data with json/ast.literal_eval, or use an allowlisted interpreter.

rules.title: Use of exec()
rules.message: exec() is a code-execution sink. Confirm inputs cannot be attacker-controlled.
rules.fix: Remove dynamic execution or strictly sandbox and allowlist.

rules.title: pickle.loads deserialization
rules.message: pickle.loads on untrusted data enables arbitrary object construction and RCE.
rules.fix: Use json/msgpack for untrusted payloads; never unpickle attacker input.

rules.title: subprocess with shell=True
rules.message: shell=True turns string building into command injection when input is tainted.
rules.fix: Pass argument lists with shell=False; never interpolate user input into a shell string.

rules.title: child_process exec with string command
rules.message: exec/execSync run through a shell. Tainted strings become command injection.
rules.fix: Use execFile/spawn with an argv array and no shell.
